concepts.def: Angles on a line, around a point, in triangles and parallel lines.
Interior and exterior angles of polygons.
Angle and chord properties of circles.
Identical shapes versus same shape, different size.
Accurate drawings using compasses and a ruler.

walkthroughs.body_html:
The angle in a semicircle is 90°.

Angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference. Opposite angles in a cyclic quadrilateral sum to 180°.

Two triangles similar with side ratio 2:3. Area ratio = (2/3)² = 4:9.

Volume ratio = (2/3)³ = 8:27.

What is the formula for the area of a circle?
options: The angle at the centre is half the angle at the circumference.
The area of a circle is 2 * pi * r — the same as the circumference formula.
The area of a circle is pi * d, where d is the diameter.
pi * r^2 (pi times the radius squared).

mcqs.q: What is the relationship between the angle at the centre and the angle at the circumference subtended by the same arc?
options: Congruent shapes are similar with different angles.
The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference.
The angle at the centre is half the angle at the circumference.
The angles are equal because they are subtended by the same arc.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between congruent and similar shapes?
options: Congruent shapes are identical in size and shape; similar shapes have the same shape but can be different sizes (scaled).
Congruent shapes are similar with different angles.
Congruent and similar both mean 'the same shape' — they're interchangeable.
The area of a circle is pi * d, where d is the diameter.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Vector”?
options: Quantity with magnitude and direction
3-digit clockwise angle from north
Same shape, sides in same ratio
Straight line between two points on a circle

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Sector”?
options: Line touching circle at exactly one point
3-digit clockwise angle from north
Pie slice of a circle, area = ½ r² θ (rad)
Same shape, sides in same ratio

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Bearing”?
options: Pie slice of a circle, area = ½ r² θ (rad)
Same shape, sides in same ratio
Straight line between two points on a circle
3-digit clockwise angle from north

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Tangent”?
options: 3-digit clockwise angle from north
Line touching circle at exactly one point
Straight line between two points on a circle
Quantity with magnitude and direction

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Chord”?
options: Same shape, sides in same ratio
Straight line between two points on a circle
Quantity with magnitude and direction
Pie slice of a circle, area = ½ r² θ (rad)

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Similar”?
options: Straight line between two points on a circle
Same shape, sides in same ratio
Pie slice of a circle, area = ½ r² θ (rad)
3-digit clockwise angle from north
